thread.title: Dalits in Muzaffarnagar threaten protests if Hindu Vahini activists not arrested

author: Jonathan Cannon
title: Dalits in Muzaffarnagar threaten protests if Hindu Vahini activists not arrested
text:
Dalits in Muzaffarnagar threaten protests if Hindu Vahini activists not arrested January 18 By Jonathan Cannon 
A Dalit youth in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar was brutally beaten by a group of youths for allegedly removing the posters of Hindu gods and putting up posters of Ambedkar. 
While three men were beating the man, one man was recording the assault. The group thrashed him and made a video of entire incident. 
According to a report by The Indian Expres , the police have identified the victim to be a dalit man in his 20s from Muzaffarnagar . 
On Wednesday, hundreds of Dalits, including Bhim Army's Uttarakhand in-charge Mahek Singh and members of Samata Sainik Dal protested, demanding the arrest of all the accused. The video clip that was shot on Sunday showed a man wearing a black helmet and lying on the ground while he was being beaten and kicked by at least 3 men. 
The assault might have been in retaliation to an incident last month when a group of Dalits had gone door-to-door in a village throwing out pictures and idols of gods and goddesses from Dalit homes, and replacing them with photographs of Bhim Rao Ambedkar, NDTV reported . At one point, the man was asked to chant Jai Mata Di . 
The case under sections 307 (attempt to murder) of IPC and the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act was registered against accused Rahul, Dhiraj, Jodha and Kaku, who were absconding, said Circle Officer Yogender Singh. 
Police said that they have spoken to the victim and his family members and the accused men have been identified as three-four Gujjar residents who live in the same area. After it went viral on social media, police took notice and registered an FIR. Omvir Singh, SP City, Muzaffarnagar , said, "Our teams are conducting raids to nab the accused".
